We drove across multiple challenging routes including SV Road, Powai, Central Line areas, Mira–Bhayandar, and even long, confidence-building drives like Sea Link and Atal Setu Road. These drives were not just lessons — they were practical, real-world experiences that truly shaped me into a confident driver.

Today, I can proudly say that I have completely overcome my fear of driving and learned how to drive properly and responsibly. Dubey Sir is far better than traditional motor driving schools because he focuses on real understanding, confidence, and safety rather than rushed or mechanical teaching.

I would highly recommend Dubey Sir to anyone who genuinely wants to learn driving the right way. His patience, professionalism, and dedication make him an exceptional instructor.
